messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] Latency SLO breached on /generate (p99=2.9s, p95=1.1s) — streaming stalls observed. Paging oncall.
Sarah L: I'm on it. getting on call — joining Zoom
Mike R: saw a spike starting ~2765431998, tail increasing. streaming tail looks worse than batch.
Priya S: can someone grab tracer for a few requests? p99 traces would help. Also any deploys in last 10m?
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T09:40:05Z by emilyc rolled to preproc-service (sha: 7f8a2c4)
Sarah L: that matches timing. @Emily C are you around?
Emily C: here — small change to prompt-template interpolation to speed up cpu, should be noop. Rolling back now.
Josh K: running quick log query: `index=preproc service=prompt-builder status=200 | stats p95(latency_ms), p99(latency_ms)` -> p99 jumped to 2800ms, p95 1100ms
Lin T: looks like JSON mode requests show longest tails. suspected tokenizer waiting on tool-schema validation step.
Priya S: confirmed: traces show time spent in prompt_renderer.parseTemplate() and tokenizer.tokenizeStream() in JSON mode.
Mike R: stack traces attached: `prompt_renderer: template_expand -> schema_merge -> compile_tools` -> this path taking ~1.8s
Sarah L: customer impact? Which routes/tenants?
Josh K: affected customers on dedicated pools + a handful on hosted API using JSON mode and streaming. Roughly 7% of traffic, top impacted customer with SLO alerts.
Priya S: mitigation options: 1) rollback deploy (Emily doing), 2) enable fallback to non-JSON-mode for streaming (feature flag), 3) increase preproc replicas to drain queue
Emily C: rollback complete — preproc-service v7f8a2c3 active
deploy-bot: Rollback successful, health checks passing.
Mike R: after rollback p99 dropped from 2.9s -> 1.7s but still above target 1.0s for some tails
Lin T: still seeing KV cache misses on tokenizer side for streaming prefixes, suggests prefix caching didn't populate during the spike
Priya S: can we enable temporary rate-limit on streaming for tenants using JSON mode? That will reduce incoming pressure while we root cause
Sarah L: @Mike R please enable rps caps for streaming endpoint for tier=standard to 5 rps via edge-config
Mike R: applied edge-config: `edgectl set-rate /generate?mode=streaming tier=standard 5rps` — applying
Mike R: edge-config applied, traffic down ~40%
Josh K: p95 now 0.95s, p99 1.25s — better but tail still noisy
Lin T: digging into tokenizer preproc logs: a hotspot in tool-schema parsing: `ToolSchemaLoader.load()` triggered a synchronous remote call to schema-service for each request
Priya S: that's the smoking gun — schema fetch per-request explodes latency under load
Josh K: can we enable local schema cache or set schema-service to respond with ETag and 304 quickly?
Lin T: schema-service already supports ETag, but preproc didn't implement caching correctly after Emily's change — it bypassed cache on JSON mode
Emily C: my change introduced always-recompile behavior to ensure correctness. I missed cache bypass. Rolling patch to re-enable per-worker LRU cache and ETag check.
Sarah L: plan: short-term keep rate limit + rollback (done) + patch and canary; mid-term add schema cache metrics and circuit-breaker; long-term add schema pre-warm and async validation
Priya S: @Josh K can you prepare a canary deploy with cache fix to 5% traffic in the next 20m?
Josh K: on it. building canary image now.
Mike R: also add a temporary alert: p99 > 1.5s for /generate streaming
Sarah L: customer comms? CX notified? we should log impacted customers and notify account leads.
Emily C: I'll open a list from query `tenant=~*jsonmode*` and tag owners. PR coming for patch: `fix/preproc-schema-cache`
deploy-bot: Canary build 7f8a2d0 ready
Josh K: canary rolled to 5% — health good
Mike R: p99 on canary ~0.45s — looks good
Lin T: monitoring schema-service error rate and cache hit ratios — currently cache hit ~0% on preproc, after canary 70% on canary shards
Priya S: slow roll to 50% then full if stable. We'll keep rate-limits in place for 30m after full roll.
Sarah L: good job. incident to postmortem: root cause = prompt-template change bypassing schema cache in JSON mode causing per-request remote schema fetches -> tokenizer tail latency. Actions: rollback, patch, add cache metrics, edge rate-limit, customer comms. Assign owners: Emily (patch), Josh (canary/deploy), Mike (edge-config/alerts), Priya (postmortem)
Mike R: assigning PagerDuty incident and updating ticket.
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged. Severity: SEV2. Pages sent to oncall.
Emily C: PR merged and rolling to 100% now.
deploy-bot: Deploy 7f8a2d0 -> preproc-service at 2026-03-15T09:56:10Z
Mike R: p99 back to 0.9s, p95 0.85s — SLOs met. closing live mitigation window.
Sarah L: thank you all. I'll start the postmortem doc and send initial customer note draft.
Priya S: add follow-up to add automatic schema prewarm on startup and a test that simulates schema-service slowness
Josh K: adding runbook entry to eng-runbooks: `preproc-jsonmode-tail` with steps we took
Emily C: sorry for the impact — will be extra careful on template changes
Sarah L: no blame, just learnings. Good teamwork :heart:
